reading: The IDM figure is a MEAN OF WITHIN-EPISODE correlations at v > 2 m/s. It is the ceiling of a predictor granted a free per-clip affine recalibration. The number a model actually faces is the pooled, out-of-sample one (wb_tier3_redundancy.json Q1). Quoting the per-episode figure as 'steer carries zero information beyond (yaw_rate, speed)' overstates it by the between-clip term.
